One Chromecast

This app is designed for Chromecast with Google TV HD, Android 14, the primary user and Proton VPN already configured. The phone uses its own pairing. The Chromecast is identified before every change.
If it cannot be found

Connect the phone and Chromecast to the same trusted local network, avoiding guest networks or device isolation. On the TV, open Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging and check that it is on. The app cannot enable it by itself. If the phone denies local network access, check the app permissions in the phone settings. The ADB client does not authenticate the TLS server certificate; pairing and identity checks do not replace a trusted LAN.
Pairing and connection

On the TV, choose pairing by code. In the app, open “Connection and pairing”, select the Chromecast or enter its IP address, pairing port and code. After pairing, return to the main Wireless debugging screen on the TV: use the connection port, which differs from the code port. You can enter it manually if discovery fails.

After confirmation, the app checks the device, saves Android always-on and kill switch for Proton, reads the settings back and only then requests a reboot. An ON configuration does not prove that the VPN tunnel is connected or certify the absence of leaks.

Removes both Android features, even if only always-on VPN was still enabled. Proton Auto-connect is a separate setting: it may still connect the VPN and is managed in the Proton app on the Chromecast.
After rebooting

The connection is expected to drop. Wait for startup and use “Read state again”. If Wireless debugging stayed off, turn it back on from the TV and search again, or enter the new connection address. Without a fresh check, the result remains unconfirmed. You do not need to keep the app open all the time.
Partial configuration or error

Do not assume the change succeeded. Restore the connection and read the state again. After checking the Chromecast, you can explicitly choose the desired operation. The app never repeats writes or reboots by itself and never disables a protection to compensate for an error.
Revoked pairing or unreadable data

If the TV revoked the phone, pair again using a new code: the same Chromecast stays selected. If the device was reset or local data is damaged, first check the configuration on the TV and complete any recovery. Only then clear this app’s data in Android settings and pair again: clearing data also deletes the record of unfinished operations.
USB recovery from a PC

If wireless access does not return, USB recovery is an option with a data cable, adequate power, USB debugging already enabled on the Chromecast and an authorized PC. The procedure deletes the three settings, verifies their removal and only then reboots. A factory reset is normally unnecessary. Read the command contract in the repository before proceeding.
